items.text: vacharirwisa kumativi ose, pazuva rokuparara kwaro.
kana kumurega achipfeka nhumbi dzake dzokurwa.
naMwari wavo, iye Jehovha Wamasimba Ose,
Bhabhironi rakanga riri mukombe wegoridhe muruoko rwaJehovha;
Torai muti webharisamu murape kurwadziwa kwaro;
ngatirisiyei mumwe nomumwe aende kunyika yake,
Jehovha Wamasimba Ose akapika naiye amene achiti:
Zvirokwazvo ndichakuzadza navarume, sezvinoitwa nechimokoto chemhashu,
uye anouyisa mhepo kubva mumatura ake.
"Munhu mumwe nomumwe haana pfungwa uye haana zivo;
mupfuri mumwe nomumwe wesimbi anonyadziswa nezvifananidzo zvake.
Iye Mugove waJakobho haana kufanana naizvozvi,
Jehovha Wamasimba Ose ndiro zita rake.
"Ndicharipira Bhabhironi navose vagere muBhabhironi pamberi pako, nokuda kwezvakaipa zvavakaita muZioni," ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha.
Hapana dombo richabviswa kwauri kuti riitwe dombo rekona,
Gadzai mukuru wehondo kuti arwe naye;
nokuti zvakarongwa naJehovha pamusoro peBhabhironi hazvingatongokoni,
Zvanzi naJehovha Wamasimba Ose, Mwari waIsraeri:
uye akazadza dumbu rake nezvinonaka zvedu,
Zvechisimba zvakaitwa panyama yedu ngazvive pamusoro peBhabhironi,"
"Ropa redu ngarive pamusoro peavo vanogara muBhabhironi."
Vanhu vake vose vanoomba seshumba diki,
rumwe runyerekupe runonzwika gore rino, rumwe gore rinouya,
uye vakaurayiwa varo vachawira pasi vose mukati maro.
Ipapo denga nenyika nezvose zviri mazviri
Ndichaita kuti machinda ake navakachenjera vake vadhakwe,
ndizvo zvinotaura Mambo, ane zita rinonzi Jehovha Wamasimba Ose.
Iri ndiro shoko rakapiwa naJeremia kumuchinda Seraya mwanakomana waNeria, mwanakomana waMaseya, paakaenda kuBhabhironi naZedhekia mambo weJudha mugore rechina rokutonga kwake.
Jeremia akanga anyora murugwaro pamusoro penjodzi dzose dzaizouya pamusoro peBhabhironi, zvose zvakanga zvakanyorwa pamusoro peBhabhironi.
Akati kuna Seraya, "Paunosvika kuBhabhironi, uone kuti waverenga mashoko ose aya uchidanidzirisa.
Ipapo uti, 'Haiwa Jehovha, makati muchaparadza nzvimbo ino, zvokuti hakuna munhu kana zvipfuwo zvingagaramo; ichaparadzwa nokusingaperi.'
Paunopedza kuverenga rugwaro urwu, sungira ibwe parwuri ugorukanda muna Yufuratesi.
Ipapo uti, 'Saizvozvo Bhabhironi richanyura rikasazomukazve nokuda kwenjodzi yandichauyisa pamusoro paro. Uye vanhu varo vachawa.' "
